title: Quality Studio performance
summary: Tracks measured startup, repository switching, tree transport, review-run latency, rendering, and long-session memory. QS-82 implements lazy tree transport and integrates QS-78 snapshot restoration without duplicating QS-54 cache work; the controlled before/after series was re-measured on 2026-08-24. The accepted 564922a5 delivery was replayed onto origin/main 88401d7 and fully re-gated on 2026-08-31: Release build, 237 portable .NET tests, 58 Angular tests, security and dependency checks, and the 13-point tree-v2 app contract all pass.
